Senior PM — Consumer Credit, London hybrid.

Nettle (London, 40 people, Series A) is building a self-serve credit-builder card for underbanked UK consumers — sign up in the app, no branch, no salesperson, product-led from day one. We're a founder-led company: our CEO and CTO still review every roadmap personally. We closed our Series A eight months ago and are still proving out our core growth loop, so it's too early to call the trajectory either way. We're hiring a Senior PM to own dispute resolution and chargeback handling on the card product — in-app dispute flows, fraud-hold communications, and the chargeback-to-issuer pipeline. No direct reports; you'll work with two engineers and a designer. Hybrid: two days a week in our London office. General consumer-credit background helps, though this dispute-and-chargeback surface is new ground for most candidates we talk to.
